integrity: Algebraic proof, positive-coefficient rational identities and a reproducible exact symbolic/rational verifier. Nonnegative all-step assertion includes h=0; strict positivity is only for h>0.
scientific_limitations: Four-vertex connected weighted paths and the completed fourth-order Gauss step only. Necessity invokes the known Laplacian Green-kernel sign framework; no independently verified priority or extension to larger trees or internal stages is claimed.
title: A unique all-step positivity tuning for fourth-order Gauss heat diffusion on a four-vertex path
